svg.title: Monitoring and target-setting workflow for CE performance levels
svg.desc: Monitoring starts from user-defined CE performance levels. Target setting starts from Phase B allocated carrying capacities and searches for CE performance levels through shared Phase A and Phase C calculations. Golden yellow arrows identify monitoring-only links; grey dashed arrows identify target-setting-only links; black arrows identify common links, including Phase B to Phase C. The bottom legend distinguishes arrow use from text colours and notation.

g.text: Initial exploration: all demand × lifetime grid combinations
Block II: Other CE parameter families
Using Block I and II results:
• Combine retained Block I + II results
• Block II results × all Block I grid combinations
• Block I results × Block II sets from the joint pairwise design
• Explore intermediate combinations at the initial spacing
Independent of Block I and II results:
• Pairwise covering design across all five CE families
At each refinement spacing, the search continues until no better combination is found, then proceeds to the next spacing.
